title: React native Range slider or query between two fields
body:
My scenario is I would like to get results between two fields. I have experience\_from and experience\_to attributes. I want to get results between these two attributes. How would I implement a custom filter refinement to accomplish this.

In algolia we do something like below
res = index.search("query term", { "filters" => "experience\_from >=1 AND experience\_to <=3"})

I would like the above implementation in React native algolia instant search.
